messages.保存后停止并重新启动已有 Codespace，让新的 Secrets 注入环境；: Stop and restart an existing codespace after saving so the new secrets enter its environment. If you have not created a codespace yet, create it after configuring the secrets.
messages.讲师提供的平台根地址，例如 https://your-company.jfrog: The platform root URL provided by your instructor, for example https://your-company.jfrog.io.
messages.讲师提供的 JFrog 平台地址，例如 https://your-company: The JFrog platform URL provided by your instructor, for example https://your-company.jfrog.io.
messages.讲师提供的 JFrog 服务地址，例如 https://your-company: The JFrog service URL provided by your instructor, for example https://your-company.jfrog.io.
messages.本人 JFrog Access Token。向讲师领取或按平台流程生成，不填写登: Your own JFrog Access Token, supplied by your instructor or generated through the platform. Do not enter your login password.
messages.本人项目 Key，例如 project1，不使用项目显示名称。: Your project key, for example project1, rather than its display name.
messages.GitHub 个人 Codespaces 设置 · 点击查看大图: Personal GitHub Codespaces settings · Click to enlarge
messages.GitHub 仓库 Codespaces 设置 · 点击查看大图: Repository Codespaces settings · Click to enlarge
messages.只在 GitHub Secrets 页面填写 Token，不将真实 Token: Enter the token only on the GitHub Secrets page. Do not put a real token in opencode.json, repository files, prompts, or terminal command history.
messages.只在 GitHub 仓库 Secrets 页面填写 Token，不将真实 Tok: Enter the token only on the repository Secrets page. Do not put a real token in opencode.json, repository files, prompts, or terminal command history.
messages.预期四个变量都显示 SET。该命令不会打印变量值。若显示 MISSING，检查: All four variables should show SET. This command does not print their values. If any shows MISSING, check the secret name and repository access, then stop and restart the codespace.
messages.预期三个变量都显示 SET。该命令不会打印变量值。若显示 MISSING，检查: All three variables should show SET. This command does not print their values. If any shows MISSING, check the secret name and repository access, then stop and restart the codespace.
messages.打开你刚刚 Fork 后的 jfrog-ai-workshop 仓库，点击 Co: Open your forked jfrog-ai-workshop repository and select Code.
messages.打开本人 Fork 后的 jfrog-ai-workshop 仓库，点击 Cod: Open your forked jfrog-ai-workshop repository and select Code.
messages.切换到 Codespaces 标签，点击 Create codespace on: Switch to the Codespaces tab and select Create codespace on main.
messages.要求 Node.js ≥ 18、OpenCode ≥ 1.17.7、JFrog: Requires Node.js ≥ 18, OpenCode ≥ 1.17.7, and JFrog CLI ≥ 2.100.0. Use the tool environment prepared by the instructor. If tools are missing or too old, ask the instructor to prepare them before continuing.
messages.Codespaces 终端 · 查询本人项目可用 MCP: Codespaces terminal · List approved MCPs for your project
messages.npx 首次会获取并运行 Agent Guard，后续可复用缓存。Agent G: On first use, npx fetches and runs Agent Guard; later runs can reuse its cache. Agent Guard authenticates with JFROG_URL and JFROG_ACCESS_TOKEN and targets JF_PROJECT.
messages.预期命令成功返回本人项目的 MCP 准入列表。列表为空不一定是安装失败：若 La: The command should return your project’s approved MCP list. An empty list does not necessarily mean setup failed: filesystem-mcp may not be approved until Lab 01. Query again after approval. Resolve any 401/403 or network errors before continuing.
messages.此命令验证 Agent Guard 的连接和项目查询，不会自动在 OpenCod: This verifies Agent Guard connectivity and project discovery; it does not add filesystem-mcp to OpenCode. Complete the OpenCode plugin setup and MCP installation in Lab 01.
messages.安装并验证 JFrog Agent Guard: Initialize and verify JFrog Agent Guard
messages.在 OpenCode 中选择 Browse MCP Servers，查看可用的: In OpenCode, select Browse MCP Servers to view the available MCP servers.
messages.在 Codespaces 左上角三横线主菜单中打开 Command Palett: In the Codespaces top-left hamburger menu, open Command Palette..., then search for and select Browse MCP Servers.
messages.找到 JFrog Plugin，点击 Start。: Find JFrog Plugin and select Start.
messages.按页面跳转到 JPD，使用本人账号完成认证授权。: Follow the redirect to JPD and complete authentication and authorization with your account.
messages.Browse MCP Servers 中启动 JFrog Plugin · 点击: Start JFrog Plugin in Browse MCP Servers · Click to enlarge
messages.预期结果：JFrog Plugin 启动成功，show log 中显示已连接服务: Expected: JFrog Plugin starts successfully, and the show log indicates that the server is connected and tools were retrieved.
messages.填写讲师分配的学员账号，仅用于生成本人 CLI Server ID。平台地址、T: Enter your assigned participant username to generate your CLI server ID. The platform URL, token and project are read from Codespaces secrets; this page does not collect tokens.
messages.Codespaces 终端 · Token 认证及验证: Codespaces terminal · Token authentication and verification
messages.先确认 JF_PROJECT 与页面显示的 projectN 一致，再执行上方命: Confirm JF_PROJECT matches the projectN shown here before running the command. The token is passed to jf c add through standard input rather than printed in command arguments. Verification should return your project details and jf rt ping should return OK.
messages.下一步的终端命令、OpenCode 操作与 Skills 上传均在这个 Code: Run the later terminal commands, OpenCode operations and Skills publishing in this codespace’s user directory. Your CLI server ID remains workshop-userN.
messages.Codespaces 已打开，本人 user 目录中的工具版本满足要求: My codespace is open and the required tool versions are available in the user directory
messages.四个 Secrets 已注入，检查结果全部为 SET: All four secrets are available and the presence check shows SET for each
messages.Agent Guard 查询成功，使用本人 JF_PROJECT，没有认证或网络: Agent Guard queried my JF_PROJECT successfully without authentication or network errors
messages.JFrog Plugin 已启动，并完成 JPD 认证授权: JFrog Plugin is started and JPD authentication and authorization are complete
messages.Codespaces 环境初始化完成，jf 验证通过: Codespaces environment initialization is complete and jf verification passed
messages.JFrog Agent Plugin 已完成安装并启动: JFrog Agent Plugin is installed and started
messages.本人 CLI 已通过 Token 配置，项目访问验证成功且 ping 返回 OK: My CLI uses token authentication, project access verification succeeded, and ping returned OK
messages.请填写讲师分配的 userN 账号，再复制验证命令。: Enter your assigned userN account before copying the verification commands.
messages.请完成 Codespaces 准备并勾选全部验证结果: Complete Codespaces setup and check all verification results
messages.Codespaces 准备完成，可以继续: Codespaces setup is complete. You can continue.
messages.在 OpenCode Agent 中输入以下提示词，创建本人项目的 Skills: Enter this prompt in OpenCode Agent to create your project’s Skills repository. The project and repository names are filled in from page one.
messages.执行成功后，在平台确认仓库类型为 Local / Skills，且归属本人项目，: After creation succeeds, verify in the platform that the repository is Local / Skills and belongs to your project before uploading.
messages.在 {project} 中创建 skills 仓库，名称 {repo}。: Create a skills repository in project {project}, named {repo}.
messages.请先在第一页填写本人账号和对应 Project。: First enter your account and corresponding Project on page one.
messages.在 OpenCode Agent 中输入以下提示词，将本地 Skill 上传到第: Enter this prompt in OpenCode Agent to upload the local Skill to the repository created in step one.
messages.Skills 扫描结果：恶意指令与敏感信息外泄风险: Skills scan results: malicious instructions and sensitive data exfiltration risks
messages.Skills 扫描结果示例 · 点击查看大图: Example Skills scan results · Click to enlarge
messages.在本人项目中进入 AI/ML → Policies，添加策略。Policy na: In your project, open AI/ML → Policies and add a policy. Enter the name below in Policy name and Description, then click Next.
messages.Scope：AI assets 选择 Skills；范围选择 Projects，: Scope: set AI assets to Skills. Select Projects and include only your own project, then click Next.
messages.Rule：选择 Block malicious（Scan result = Ma: Rule: select Block malicious (Scan result = Malicious), then click Next.
messages.Actions & waivers：确认动作为 Block，Waiver req: Actions & waivers: confirm Block, set Waiver request settings to Not allowed, then click Next and complete saving. Verify that the policy is active.
messages.完成配置后，在 OpenCode Agent 输入以下提示词，验证恶意 Skil: After configuration, enter this prompt in OpenCode Agent to verify that the policy blocks installation and download of the malicious Skill.
messages.预期结果：安装下载明确因 Policy / Block malicious 被拒: Expected: installation/download is explicitly denied by Policy / Block malicious and the Skill is not installed into skills/download. Network, authentication, or schema errors do not count as a successful policy block. If this version is already cached, ask the instructor for a clean verification environment.
messages.已配置本人项目的 Block malicious 策略，并确认 skills-e: Configured Block malicious for my project and verified that the policy blocks installation/download of skills-e2e-single@0.0.1
messages.使用 workshopadmin 账号登录 JFrog 平台，再进行以下策略配置: Sign in to the JFrog Platform as workshopadmin before configuring the policy below.
messages.请讲师检查 Skills 扫描服务是否已启用、仓库是否开启 Xray 索引。: Ask the instructor to check whether Skills scanning is enabled and Xray indexing is enabled for the repository.
messages.进入 AI/ML → Policies，添加策略。Policy name 和 D: Open AI/ML → Policies and add a policy. Enter the name below in Policy name and Description, then click Next.
messages.预期结果：安装下载明确因 Policy / Block malicious 被拒: Expected: installation/download is explicitly denied by Policy / Block malicious, and the Skill is not installed into skills/download.
messages.在 {project} 中创建 skills 仓库，名称 {repo}，并开启: Create a skills repository in project {project}, named {repo}, and enable Xray scanning.
messages.通过 Catalog 查看恶意包信息，再通过 OpenCode Agent 验证: Inspect malicious package information in Catalog, then use OpenCode Agent to verify that JFrog blocks the installation request.
messages.在 Catalog 中查看恶意包: Inspect the malicious package in Catalog
messages.打开 Catalog → Explore，搜索 npm 包 axios。: Open Catalog → Explore and search for the npm package axios.
messages.Version 选择 1.14.1，查看 Malicious Info 中的恶意: Select version 1.14.1 and review the verdict and details in Malicious Info.
messages.axios 1.14.1 恶意包与下载阻断示例 · 点击查看大图: axios 1.14.1 malicious package and download block example · Click to enlarge
messages.通过 Agent 验证安装拦截: Verify installation blocking through the Agent
messages.在 Workshop 的 user 目录启动 OpenCode，在 Agent: Start OpenCode from the workshop user directory and enter this prompt in the Agent chat:
messages.在 npm 目录下安装 axios 1.14.1: Install axios 1.14.1 in the npm directory
messages.预期结果：Agent 的安装请求被 JFrog 拦截，提示版本受策略限制或下载被: Expected: JFrog blocks the Agent installation request with a policy restriction or download-blocked message, and axios 1.14.1 is not installed. Record the actual blocking message.
messages.已在 Catalog 查看 axios 1.14.1 的恶意判定及下载限制: Reviewed the malicious verdict and download restriction for axios 1.14.1 in Catalog
messages.已确认 npm 安装经过 Artifactory，并看到 JFrog 明确拦截: Confirmed npm installation is routed through Artifactory and observed JFrog explicitly blocking the axios 1.14.1 installation request
messages.完成 MCP Marketplace 准入配置后，退出浏览器中当前登录的 JPD: After completing the MCP Marketplace approval configuration, sign out of the current JPD (JFrog Platform) account in the browser before authenticating as a participant.
messages.弹出 JPD 登录页面后，请使用当前学员账号 {user} 登录并授权，不要使用: When the JPD sign-in page opens, sign in and authorize as your participant account {user}, not workshopadmin. JFrog CLI and MCP OAuth authentication are independent.
messages.查看 Skill 适用的 Policy: View the policies applicable to the Skill
messages.策略配置完成后，退出 workshopadmin，使用本人学员账号登录 JPD，: After configuring the policy, sign out of workshopadmin, sign in to the JPD with your participant account, and select your Project. Open AI/ML → AI Security → Registry → Skills and locate the uploaded skills-e2e-single.
messages.点击 skills-e2e-single，选择版本 0.0.1，打开 Polic: Open skills-e2e-single, select version 0.0.1, and open the Policies tab. Review the policies applicable to the current project and check Policy name, Scope, Rule, and Action. Action should be Block.
messages.Skill 适用策略 · 点击查看大图: Applicable Skill policies · Click to enlarge
messages.初始化环境前，先在终端执行以下命令，将 Workshop 仓库下载到本机并进入学: Before initializing the environment, run these commands in a terminal to clone the Workshop repository and enter the participant directory.
messages.策略配置完成后，退出 workshopadmin，使用普通用户账号登录 JPD，: After configuring the policy, sign out of workshopadmin, sign in to the JPD with a regular user account, and select your Project. Open AI/ML → AI Security → Registry → Skills and locate the uploaded skills-e2e-single.
messages.通过 JFrog Catalog 可以查看恶意组件信息，再通过客户端 Agent: Use JFrog Catalog to inspect malicious component information, then use the client Agent to verify whether JFrog blocks malicious package installation requests.

messages.在工程 jfrog-ai-workshop 的 user 目录启动 OpenCo: Start OpenCode in the user directory of jfrog-ai-workshop and enter the following in the Agent chat:

messages.弹出 JPD 登录页面后，请使用当前学员账号 {user} 登录并授权。: When the JPD sign-in page opens, sign in and authorize with your current participant account {user}.
messages.本次 Workshop 通过 GitHub Codespaces 实验环境完成。: This Workshop is completed in a GitHub Codespaces environment.

messages.验证效果：客户端通过 filesystem-mcp 的 view tool 读取: Expected result: the client reads and displays the file content through the filesystem-mcp view tool.
